meta.name: Flint Strike Technique
meta.description: A self-taught flint profession perk passed down by slag recyclers. It grants you the rough intuition to channel a portion of your wasted overkill strike directly into the four surrounding blocks, fracturing them passively.
meta.author: jules:session
